content.value_statement: Localization issues can block product launches and create poor user experiences. This skill guides i18n setup, translation coverage checks, hardcoded string detection, and RTL planning.
actual_capabilities: Explains core i18n, localization, locale, and RTL concepts.
Shows implementation patterns for React, Next.js, and Python gettext.
Recommends locale folder structures and feature-based namespaces.
Provides a checklist for translation keys, locale files, formatting, and fallbacks.
Includes a Python checker for hardcoded strings and missing translation keys.
Advises CSS logical properties and icon mirroring for RTL layouts.
limitations: The checker uses heuristics and can miss complex dynamic text.
The script limits code file analysis to the first 50 matched files.
It does not translate content or judge translation quality.
Locale completeness checks focus on JSON and gettext-style file discovery.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Web App for Multiple Locales
use_cases.description: Review translation key usage, locale structure, and fallback handling before adding new languages.

use_cases.title: Check Release Readiness

use_cases.title: Plan RTL Support

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic i18n Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project for basic i18n readiness. Check translation keys, locale files, and fallback language behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for a project starting localization work.

prompt_templates.title: Find Hardcoded User Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the main UI files and list user-facing strings that should move into translation files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate cleanup before adding a new locale.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Locale Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare supported locale files and identify missing or extra translation keys by namespace.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release check for translation completeness.

prompt_templates.title: Design an RTL Migration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized RTL support plan for this application, including layout, icons, forms, and testing steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced localization planning for right-to-left languages.

output_examples.input: Review a React checkout page for localization issues.
output_examples.output: The review identifies hardcoded button labels, date formatting without locale options, and a missing fallback for payment errors.

output_examples.input: Compare English and Turkish locale coverage.
output: The Turkish auth namespace is missing two password reset messages.
The English checkout namespace has one extra shipping label.
Both locales share the same common navigation keys.

output_examples.input: Assess readiness for Arabic RTL support.
output_examples.output: The assessment recommends logical CSS spacing, direction-aware form alignment, icon mirroring review, and visual tests for key flows.

best_practices: Use stable translation keys and group them by feature or namespace.
Format dates, numbers, and currencies through locale-aware APIs.
Test layouts with longer text, missing translations, and RTL direction.
anti_patterns: Do not concatenate translated sentence fragments in application code.
Do not place user-facing text directly inside components.
Do not assume every language uses the same text length or direction.

faq.question: Does this skill translate my application text?
faq.answer: No. It helps find localization gaps and improve i18n structure, but it does not produce final translations.

faq.question: Which frameworks are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance covers React, Next.js, Python gettext, Vue-style patterns, and general web localization practices.

faq.question: Can it detect every hardcoded string?
faq.answer: No. The checker uses patterns and should be combined with code review and localization tests.

faq.question: Does it support RTL languages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for direction handling, CSS logical properties, and mirrored icons.

faq.question: What files does the checker inspect?
faq.answer: It searches common locale directories, JSON translation files, gettext files, and selected React, Vue, and Python source files.

faq.question: Is it safe for private repositories?
faq.answer: The bundled checker reads local project files and prints findings locally. Review file access before running it on sensitive projects.
